scope: PROSPECTIVE SYNTHETIC TEST - NOT REAL-WORLD VALIDATION

baseline_tuning.selection_rule: Maximize selection Top-1, then macro F1; grid order breaks remaining ties. Minimize calibration NLL separately.
baseline_tuning.class_balancing: Training-only class_weight None vs balanced; no sample duplication or validation/test resampling

frozen.conformal_method: Fixed LAC score=1-p(true), ceil((n+1)*.90) order statistic; no test optimization
frozen.limitations: Synthetic only. Development cohorts previously exposed in historical experiments; prospective test generated after freeze. Not independent real-world or attack-family validation. Deduplication and temporal ordering limit exchangeability guarantees.
